brief: Prioritise Harrowgate Ridge for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Review any outstanding work against its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat, prioritising active leaks, oil levels, and ventilation defects ([SOP-016]). If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]).
